customManagers.description: uv version (pinned in Dockerfile ARG UV_VERSION). Tracked from PyPI for the version list; the Dockerfile downloads the matching per-arch uv binary via wget from GitHub releases with a `sha256sum -c` check (the official ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv image lacks an armv7 manifest, which we still target). The ARG UV_VERSION regex still matches, so tracking works; only this comment was stale.

packageRules.description: Group the aiohttp/aioprometheus pair — they move together.

Group astral-sh/uv updates across the GitHub Action (setup-uv) and the Dockerfile pip-installed package (uv on PyPI) — they release in lockstep. On a uv bump the Dockerfile's per-arch UV_SHA256_* ARGs go stale (Renovate bumps UV_VERSION but can't recompute the companion binary checksums); the postUpgradeTask refreshes them in-branch from the new release's dist-manifest.json, so the bump + hash refresh land in one commit. Self-hosted Renovate CE only (the command must be on RENOVATE_ALLOWED_POST_UPGRADE_COMMANDS); replaces the retired renovate-uv-shas.yml follow-up-commit workflow.
Group the demo stack images (prom/prometheus + grafana/grafana). They're only used by the local demo Compose file, so a single grouped PR keeps the noise down.

Hold the python image of the Dockerfile at 3.14 or lower. The release builds linux/arm/v7 on Alpine. orjson arrives through aioprometheus, and pyproject.toml caps it at `orjson<3.12`, because orjson 3.12.0 stopped publishing musllinux armv7l wheels. orjson publishes Python 3.15 (cp315) musllinux wheels only from 3.12.0, so no orjson version satisfies both and the 3.15 image build fails. The regex allows the tags 3.0 to 3.14, with or without a patch part. A semver range such as `<3.15` rejects three-part tags like `3.14.4-alpine`, because Renovate reads the suffix as a prerelease. Digest updates of the current tag do not go through `allowedVersions`, so they continue. Remove this rule when orjson publishes musllinux armv7l wheels again, or when dump1090-exporter drops linux/arm/v7.
